config.notes: PROOF RUN (migrated from the published BENCHMARKS.md head-to-head, main@c66668c, 2026-07-11). Small, deliberately-short proof draft: 74 optimizer steps / 2 epochs over a ~19K-sample target-hidden-state cache, global_batch_size=512, on 2xGB10 (requires the flex->dense-sdpa-mask fix and step-time-decay mitigations from GB10-TRAINING-NOTES.md). Metric is mean accepted length (1 + mean accepted draft tokens; 7 tokens proposed per step). Aggregate first-token acceptance ~21% (vs EAGLE-3 ~11%). Eval: DeepSpec acceptance eval, 10-15 prompts per task, 128 max new tokens. Small samples -- trust the direction (DSpark wins all nine tasks), not the third decimal. This is ~1-2% of a production training budget, NOT a production checkpoint. Per-task acceptance was not reported separately, so only accepted_length is recorded here.
